title: Hegemonic Globalization
authors: Broner, Fernando, Alberto, MartÃ­n,, Meyer, Josefin, Trebesch, Christoph
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How do shifts in the global balance of power shape the world economy? We propose a theory of alignment-based "hegemonic globalization,â€ built on two central premises: countries differ in their preferences over policies (such as the rule of law or regulatory frameworks) and trade between any two countries increases with the degree of alignment in these policies. Hegemons promote policy alignment and thereby facilitate deeper trade integration. A unipolar world, dominated by a single hegemon, tends to support globalization. However, the transition to a multipolar world can trigger fragmentation, which is particularly costly for the declining hegemon and its closest allies. To test the theory, we use international treaties as a proxy for alignment and compile a novel "Global Treaty Database,â€ covering 77,000 agreements signed between 1800 and 2020. Consistent with the theory, we find that hegemons account for a disproportionate share of global treaty activity and that treaty-signing is a leading indicator of increasing bilateral trade.
abstract_zh: 全球权力格局的变迁如何塑造世界经济？本文提出一种基于政策协调的"霸权全球化"理论，其核心前提有二：各国对政策（如法治体系或监管框架）存在偏好差异，且两国间的贸易规模随政策协调程度提升而扩大。霸权国通过推动政策协调促进贸易深度融合。由单一霸权主导的单极世界往往有利于全球化进程，但向多极世界的转型可能引发体系碎片化，这对衰落中的霸权国及其核心盟友造成的代价尤为高昂。为验证该理论，我们以国际条约作为政策协调的代理变量，构建了涵盖1800年至2020年间7.7万项协定的新型"全球条约数据库"。实证结果与理论预测一致：霸权国在全球条约活动中占据不成比例的份额，且条约签署是双边贸易增长的先行指标。

title: R&D Cooperation and Spillovers: Some Empirical Evidence
title_zh: 研发合作与溢出效应：若干经验证据
authors: Reinhilde Veugelers, Bruno Cassiman, Vincent Laferrière, João Montez, Catherine Roux 等
official: 官方在线 1999-12-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Our results on the relationship between R&D spillovers and cooperation in R&D suggest that it is necessary to distinguish different aspects of external information flows. We construct firm-specific measures of incoming spillovers and appropriability from survey data on Belgian manufacturing firms. Incoming spillovers measure the importance of publicly available information for the innovation process of the firm. Appropriability is defined as the effectiveness of several protection mechanisms for appropriating the benefits of successful innovations. The decision to cooperate with research institutes is mainly affected by the level of incoming spillovers, while appropriability plays an important role for cooperating with suppliers or customers. Furthermore, we analyze what determines the levels of incoming spillovers and appropriability, including a possible simultaneous relation with cooperative agreements in R&D.
abstract_zh: 关于研发溢出与研发合作之间关系的研究结果表明，有必要区分外部信息流的不同方面。我们利用比利时制造业企业的调查数据，构建了企业层面的流入溢出与可占有性指标。流入溢出衡量的是公开可用信息对企业创新过程的重要性，而可占有性则定义为多种保护机制在获取成功创新收益方面的有效性。与科研机构合作的决策主要受流入溢出水平的影响，而与供应商或客户合作时，可占有性则起着重要作用。此外，我们分析了影响流入溢出与可占有性水平的因素，包括其与研发合作协议之间可能存在的同期关系。

title: Reconstruction following Destruction: Entrepreneurship in the Aftermath of a Natural Disaster
title_zh: 毁灭后的重建：自然灾害后的创业活动
authors: Lombardo, Richard, Frankenberg, Elizabeth, Thomas, Duncan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Little is known about the impact on small-scale enterprises of a large negative shock that destroys assets and disrupts local markets. We document the short- and long-run impacts of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami using longitudinal household survey data. We leverage topography-driven variation in exposure to the tsunami in coastal Aceh and North Sumatra, Indonesia. There are large short-run declines in business ownership, real profits, and real business assets among those exposed to the tsunami relative to comparison individuals who were not directly exposed. The gap in ownership rates disappears within two years in the non-agricultural sector but persists for 15 years in the agricultural sector. Profits and business assets of the exposed remain substantially lower through the long-term. Tsunami exposure led to increased short-duration transitions into and out of business ownership. Housing aid is linked to higher rates of non-agricultural business ownership and profits.
abstract_zh: 关于大规模负面冲击对小型企业的影响——这种冲击会摧毁资产并扰乱当地市场——目前所知甚少。我们利用纵向家庭调查数据，记录了2004年印度洋海啸的短期与长期影响。我们借助地形驱动的暴露差异，分析了印度尼西亚亚齐省和北苏门答腊省沿海地区受海啸影响的程度。与未直接暴露的对照组个体相比，受海啸影响的个体在商业所有权、实际利润和实际商业资产方面出现了显著的短期下降。非农业部门的商业所有权差距在两年内消失，但农业部门的差距持续了15年。受冲击者的利润和商业资产在长期内仍显著较低。海啸暴露导致商业所有权的短期进出频率增加。住房援助与非农业商业所有权及利润率的提高相关。

title: Divisive by Design: Shaping Values in Optimal Mechanisms
title_zh: 设计分裂：最优机制中的价值观塑造
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study a principal who allocates a good to agents with private, independently distributed values through an optimal mechanism. The principal can strategically shape these value distributions by modifying the good’s features, which affect agents’ valuations. Our analysis reveals that optimal designs are frequently divisive – creating goods that appeal strongly to specific agents or agent types while being less valued by others. These divisive designs reduce information rents and increase total surplus, even though they reduce competition. Even when total surplus is constrained, some divisiveness in designs remains optimal.
abstract_zh: 我们研究一位委托人通过最优机制将商品分配给具有私人且独立分布价值的代理人。委托人可以通过调整商品特性来策略性地塑造这些价值分布，从而影响代理人的估值。分析表明，最优设计往往具有分化性——即创造出的商品对特定代理人或代理人类型具有强烈吸引力，而其他代理人对其评价较低。这种分化设计虽然减少了竞争，但降低了信息租金并增加了总剩余。即使在总剩余受到约束的情况下，设计中保留一定程度的分化性仍是最优选择。

title: DP21689 Transportation Infrastructure and Urban and Regional Development
title_zh: 交通基础设施与城市及区域发展
authors: Gilles Duranton, Matthew Turner, Gilles Duranton; Matthew Turner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The literature assessing the effects of transportation infrastructure on how people and economic activity distribute themselves across a system of cities has three main parts. The theoretical literature makes robust predictions about how transportation infrastructure affects the internal structure of cities, but for systems of cities, theory does not let us rule much out. The city-level empirical literature establishes that improved urban transportation infrastructure causes suburban migration, but has only a small impact on city population. This literature is less helpful for understanding the effects of transportation infrastructure on the way people are distributed across a system of cities, but has made some progress. The small empirical literature looking at how transportation infrastructure affects systems of cities using cross-country data remains underdeveloped and is inconclusive.
abstract_zh: 评估交通基础设施如何影响人口与经济活动在城市体系中的分布，相关文献主要包含三个部分。理论文献对交通基础设施如何影响城市内部结构做出了稳健的预测，但对于城市体系而言，理论并未能排除太多可能性。城市层面的实证研究表明，城市交通基础设施的改善会导致郊区迁移，但对城市人口规模的影响较小。这类文献在理解交通基础设施如何影响人口在城市体系中的分布方面帮助有限，但已取得一定进展。利用跨国数据研究交通基础设施如何影响城市体系的少量实证文献仍不成熟，且结论尚无定论。

title: Production Networks and the (Asymmetric) Transmission of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 生产网络与货币政策的（非对称）传导

abstract: I study how the production network shapes monetary policy transmission to prices. Using U.S. data, I show that industries farther upstream from final demand exhibit larger cumulative price responses to monetary shocks, while downstream industries absorb shocks through output. A calibrated multi-sector New Keynesian model rationalizes these patterns: upstream sectors, which sell predominantly to other firms, reprice more frequently and therefore exhibit less price rigidity. A counterfactual decomposition of the price response shows that this heterogeneity in price rigidity---rather than cost-cascade propagation through input-output linkages---is the primary driver of the cross-sectional responses. title: Leaning Against Inflation Experiences
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A large share of secular variation in real interest rates can be understood as the effect of monetary policy leaning against experience-based long-run inflation expectations. Survey microdata show that adaptive learning from experienced inflation generates highly persistent, slow-moving long-run inflation expectations. When expectations are shaped by experience, central banks cannot anchor them through communication. Instead, when expectations deviate from the inflation target, monetary policy must remain persistently hawkish or dovish to generate realized inflation outcomes that, through agents’ belief updating, gradually pull long-run expectations back toward the target. Consistent with this mechanism, I find a strong positive relationship between experience-based long-run inflation expectations and real interest rates in the U.S., Germany, the U.K., and Japan. Under their subjective expectations, private-sector agents do not anticipate future reversals in inflation and short-term real interest rates. As a result, long-term real interest rates move with experience-based long-run inflation expectations about as much as short-term real interest rates do, consistent with the data. Secular movements in real rates are also accompanied by persistent patterns in interest-rate forecast errors. Overall, the interaction of monetary policy and learning from experience generates a distinct source of secular real-rate variation, beyond movements in the natural rate of interest.
abstract_zh: 实际利率长期波动的很大一部分可以理解为货币政策对抗基于经验的长期通胀预期的影响。调查微观数据显示，基于经历通胀的自适应学习会产生高度持久、缓慢变动的长期通胀预期。当预期由经验塑造时，央行无法通过沟通来锚定这些预期。相反，当预期偏离通胀目标时，货币政策必须持续保持鹰派或鸽派立场，以产生实际通胀结果，通过经济主体的信念更新，逐步将长期预期拉回目标水平。与这一机制一致，我发现美国、德国、英国和日本的基于经验的长期通胀预期与实际利率之间存在强正相关关系。在其主观预期下，私营部门经济主体并未预期未来通胀和短期实际利率会出现逆转。因此，长期实际利率随基于经验的长期通胀预期变动的幅度与短期实际利率大致相同，这与数据一致。实际利率的长期波动还伴随着利率预测误差的持续性模式。总体而言，货币政策与经验学习的相互作用，在自然利率变动之外，产生了实际利率长期波动的独特来源。

title: Income distribution, taxation and shifting in a federal fiscal structure
title_zh: 联邦财政结构中的收入分配、税收与转移
authors: Federico Revelli, Tsung‐Sheng Tsai, Roberto Zotti
abstract: We study income tax competition in a structure of two adjacent two‐tier (federal‐regional) fiscal federations, where both upper‐tier and lower‐tier authorities tax income in the presence of income shifting within and between the federations. We show that when the federations are symmetric, horizontal competition leads to income‐shifting flows from rich regions (setting higher income tax rates) to poor regions (setting lower tax rates), both within and between federations. Moreover, income‐shifting facilities intensify tax competition, potentially increasing income redistribution from wealthier to poorer regions. However, in the case of asymmetric federations, the relationship between regional income tax rate and tax base and the resulting direction of inter‐regional income‐shifting flows are ambiguous due to the operation of vertical and diagonal fiscal externalities.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个由两个相邻的两级（联邦-地区）财政联邦制构成的收入税收竞争结构，其中，在存在联邦内部及联邦之间收入转移的情况下，上级和下级政府均对收入征税。研究表明，当联邦对称时，横向竞争会导致收入从富裕地区（设定较高所得税率）向贫困地区（设定较低税率）转移，这种转移既发生在联邦内部，也发生在联邦之间。此外，收入转移机制加剧了税收竞争，可能增加从富裕地区向贫困地区的收入再分配。然而，在非对称联邦的情况下，由于纵向和对角财政外部性的作用，地区所得税率与税基之间的关系以及由此产生的地区间收入转移方向具有不确定性。
